<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919272_theRebbe_883" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919272_theRebbe_883__p008">
  <section v="21">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the service of Israel in the final moments of exile is with self-sacrifice, a miracle within a miracle, leading to the division of the land by lot and the true and complete redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">9)</t>
    <t s="2">And this is “You have given to those who fear You a banner to be raised high, because of truth, Selah,”</t>
    <t s="3">for the truth of Avraham is in a manner of Selah,</t>
    <t s="4">forever,</t>
    <t s="5">that even at the end of all worlds, in the generation of the heels of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="6">and in this itself, in the last moments of the exile,</t>
    <t s="7">behold, the service of Israel is with self-sacrifice,</t>
    <t s="8">the aspect of a miracle within a miracle in the soul,</t>
    <t s="9">for not only do they have the matter of the horns,</t>
    <t s="10">but moreover,</t>
    <t s="11">they are in a manner of “the horns of the righteous shall be raised high”</t>
    <t s="12">(and as Rashi explains, that it refers to Israel, who are the praise of the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="13">the Righteous One of the world).</t>
    <t s="14">And through this, “May Your beloved ones be rescued, save with Your right hand and answer me,”</t>
    <t s="15">for the salvations of the right hand in the time of exile are in a manner of “He turned back His right hand.”</t>
    <t s="16">And this is through the revelation of the aspect of a lot for each and every one,</t>
    <t s="17">“and you shall stand for your lot at the end of the days,”</t>
    <t s="18">the aspect of “You maintain my lot.”</t>
    <t s="19">And through this is done</t>
    <t s="20">(but by lot)</t>
    <t s="21">“he shall divide the land”</t>
    <t s="22">(and in the two versions in the manuscripts of the Maamarim 199,</t>
    <t s="23">“he shall divide” and “it shall be divided”),</t>
    <t s="24">the division of the land literally</t>
    <t s="25">(for nothing departs from its plain meaning),</t>
    <t s="26">and below ten handbreadths, in the true and complete redemption through Moshiach our Righteous One,</t>
    <t s="27">for then there will be the conquest of the complete Land of Israel,</t>
    <t s="28">and afterwards the conquest of the land of the Kenite, the Kenizzite, and the Kadmonite,</t>
    <t s="29">and afterwards “the L-rd your G-d will expand your border,”</t>
    <t s="30">an inheritance without boundaries.</t>
    <t s="31">And since all this is done through the aspect of the lot, which is above time and space,</t>
    <t s="32">therefore there is no need at all for a length of time, but rather as the language of the Alter Rebbe 200,</t>
    <t s="33">“a day that is entirely long,” meaning that even at its beginning it is long,</t>
    <t s="34">for in a single moment the true and complete redemption comes with all its details and completeness,</t>
    <t s="35">until “the L-rd your G-d will expand your border,”</t>
    <t s="36">specifically through the L-rd 201</t>
    <t s="37">(in the manner of “You specifically maintain my lot”),</t>
    <t s="38">very soon with the coming of Moshiach our Righteous One,</t>
    <t s="39">that the Holy One, blessed be He, leads Israel with upright stature in the true and complete redemption,</t>
    <t s="40">and “He will raise the horn of His Moshiach” 202,</t>
    <t s="41">and these days will be turned to joy and gladness and good festivals 203,</t>
    <t s="42">speedily in our days.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
